📖 How to Play & Features

1. Sudoku Objective: Fill every 9×9 row, column, and 3×3 block with digits 1–9 without repeating any number.

2. Backtracking Visualizer: Click ▶ Solve or ⏭ Step to watch the recursive algorithm test candidates and backtrack when a conflict arises.

3. Cozy Kalimba Melody: Toggle 🎵 Melody ON/OFF in the top bar to play or mute the procedural music-box background melody and tactile wooden tile chimes.
